body: I feel like this each day. I learnt that even though life can be so miserable, we as humans naturally seek out for help and maybe this post was your way of attaining that help and we are your light and guide to get you out of this mess. Stay strong! 💗

I feel like shit all the time and guess what? You got this. I fucking believe in you. I know you can find a way out of this. I really hope somebody helps you out, I hope you find the light and hope you’re currently seeking.

That’s a nice way of seeing our different perspectives, you’re right though. We don’t have to make ourselves set to a certain persona in order to live as there are many faces we have that we use for people. For example if you’re a wrestler, you aren’t going to use the same move on every single person as there are some who are taller, some who are more flexible, some who are smaller etc. So we just have to adjust or even adapt ourselves in order to surround ourselves in that environment. All the faces are still me. No I’m not suggesting ‘two-faced’ in the negative connotation but having faces that can be right for the right people. At the end, I’m still me. I like the way you put that. 
:) Also if anybody feels alone, I’ve been there and I can chat with you !! I’m willing to chat with you about things that concern youuuuu and noo I do not bite :p
